correctness.rationale: An exact Binet/binomial/geometric-series identity reduces the inverse tail to the reciprocal of one analytic power series near zero. Expanding that reciprocal and the known g_n in the same local variable yields the stated exact coefficients and O(F_n^-5) remainder. Symbolic radical identities and direct high-precision tail evaluations agree.

originality.rationale: The inspected 2025 and 2026 primary sources establish a difference-to-zero cubic approximation, and the newest paper strengthens it to a 2/F_n algebraic window, but no sharp scaled residual constant, parity-dependent next coefficient, or all-order local expansion was located. Wan--Liang--Liao explicitly reduce their Fibonacci cubic specialization to the 2025 theorem.

value.rationale: The result replaces a coarse eventual error coefficient 2 by the sharp asymptotic constant (948+72 sqrt(5))/3509, resolves the next oscillatory term, and gives a reusable exact analytic expansion mechanism to arbitrary order.
